Heh, hehehehehe...
Everyone's goin' nuts now...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Miu for a while?

O-Of course...th-there's no way I'd ever
believe that k-kinda unscientific bullshit...

<CLT=cltMIND>Despite her tough words, she spent
most of the day clinging to me...

<CLT=cltMIND>I somehow ended up growing
a little closer to Miu...
